title: Resistance: Fall of Man
why: A launch title that showed what the console could do on day one. It's also the disc that failed in our founder's console.

title: Folklore
why: A dreamlike action RPG set between an Irish village and the land of the dead, and one of the console's most overlooked exclusives.

title: Heavenly Sword
why: A cinematic action game whose performance capture was directed by Andy Serkis. It remains a PS3 exclusive.

title: Ratchet & Clank Future: Tools of Destruction
why: A bright, inventive platform shooter that brought the series into HD. It has never had a native re-release.

title: LittleBigPlanet
why: 'Play, Create, Share' brought user-made levels to the console mainstream; millions of player creations lived online.
lost: Online servers shut down (verify exact date)

title: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
why: A console-exclusive that leaned on Blu-ray capacity and the Cell processor for a cinematic finale to a landmark series.
lost: Metal Gear Online, its multiplayer mode, shut down in 2012 (verify)

title: Demon's Souls
why: Started the soulslike genre and its asynchronous online messages, leading to Dark Souls and Elden Ring.
lost: Original online servers shut down in 2018 (verify)

title: Flower
why: You play as the wind carrying petals: a short, calming game that helped make the case for games as art.

title: Killzone 2
why: Its heavy, atmospheric shooting made it a technical showcase for the Cell, and it was never remastered.

title: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves
why: It set the bar for cinematic action games and is widely called one of the best games of its generation.

title: inFamous
why: An open-world superhero game where your moral choices reshaped both your powers and the city.

title: God of War III
why: The trilogy's huge, brutal finale, famous for its sense of scale.

title: Gran Turismo 5
why: The series' giant PS3 entry, with more than 1,000 cars, and one of the console's best-selling games.

title: Heavy Rain
why: An interactive drama where any of the four main characters can die and the story carries on without them.

title: MAG
why: Online battles for up to 256 players on one map, a record for a console shooter.
lost: Online-only: when its servers shut down in 2014, the whole game became unplayable (verify)

title: Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch
why: A storybook RPG with animation by Studio Ghibli and music by Joe Hisaishi.

title: Journey
why: A short, wordless game that proved games could be art, and a milestone for indie digital distribution.

title: Tokyo Jungle
why: A survival game about animals in a deserted Tokyo: strange, funny, and only ever released on this console.

title: Puppeteer
why: A puppet-theatre platformer where every level plays out on a stage. It was never re-released.

title: The Last of Us
why: A late-generation peak, showing what studios that had mastered the Cell processor could achieve.
